method: Headless local Google Chrome via Playwright, plus manual inspection of exported screenshots and cover contact sheet.
result: No batch layout correction needed; mobile tables scroll within their container, body photos decode and remain within viewport, source and TOC links are present. Public captions and alt text do not carry AI-production notices.
scope: All 60 locale article routes checked for mobile horizontal overflow; list pages 1–3 checked at both viewports; selected article desktop screenshots, body photos, table scrolling, TOC and educational CTA locale behavior checked. This is a local preview audit, not a production-device or accessibility certification.
